description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-05-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Dr. (Mrs.) E.R.S.P. Edirimanna, who served in the Post of Director General of Agriculture has retired from the service on 2025-05-18. The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation to appoint  Dr. W.A.R.T. Wickramaarachchi, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Agriculture Service, presently serving in a Post of Additional Secretary of the Ministry of  Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, to the Post of  Director General of Agriculture fallen vacant accordingly with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.
